# infeasible-window-explained

Synthetic, the draft's own example (§6.4): Portsmouth at 10:30 and Pulborough at 10:45 cannot both
be kept; they are about 66 minutes apart. Each fits alone; Portsmouth wins on least driving
(home → Portsmouth → home 87 minutes against about 90 for Pulborough). Pulborough comes back
unassigned with reason `window` and the lateness its cheapest insertion would cause (about 66
minutes: "You'd be about 66 minutes late"), so the user can move it or change its time.
